name: Plus Minus
description: Given an array of integers, calculate the ratios of its elements that are positive, negative, and zero. Return each ratio with 6 digits after the decimal point.
shortDescription: Ratios of positive, negative and zero elements

explanation.idea: Count positives, negatives and zeros in one pass, then divide each count by the total.
explanation.analogy: A class survey of yes, no and undecided: tally the answers, then turn each tally into a share of the class.

computeWithCounting.summary: One loop with three counters, then format the three ratios.
steps: Divide each count by the length as a double (casting first avoids integer division).
format prints each ratio with 6 decimal places.

computeWithStreams.summary: Two filtered counts; zeros are whatever is left.
steps: count values > 0 with a stream filter.

pitfalls: Integer division: 3 / 6 is 0 in Java; cast to double first.
String.format uses your computer's locale, so some systems print 0,500000 with a comma. Pass Locale.US when the output format matters.
interview: HackerRank warm-up: the points being tested are integer division and output formatting.
